source.author: verg
source.text: Fit via vi; rumpunt aditus, primosque trucidant immissi Danai, et late loca milite complent.
source.text_original: Fit via vi; rumpunt aditus, primosque trucidant / immissi Danai, et late loca milite complent.
source.text_english: The way is made by force; the Greeks break through the approaches and, rushing in, butcher the front ranks, and widely fill the place with troops.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Fit fragor; irrumpunt foribus qui saeva ferebant imperia et strictos iussis regalibus enses.
reuse.text_original: Fit fragor; irrumpunt foribus qui saeva ferebant / imperia et strictos iussis regalibus enses.
reuse.text_english: A crash arises; those who brought savage orders and swords drawn at the royal command burst in through the doors.
